user_query: gmail entries in any workspace about a flights airlines and search trass.tg also

intent.goal: Find email entries about flights/airlines and search trass.tg database

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.body_snippet
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'tg')
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%flight%' OR 
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%airline%' OR
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%flight%' OR 
    LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%airline%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%flight%' OR
    LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%airline%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%flight%' OR
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%airline%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
